{{Top|leg}}
'''Ko-shol gas''' was a gas present on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in high concentrations. Its potency near the lavas which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was burned alive led to scarring of his [[Lung/Legends|lungs]], rendering them useless. Because of this, he then required the use of a [[breathing regulator]] in place of lungs.
